name: io.github.dienhokhanh/google-search-console-mcp
title: Google Search Console MCP
description: Query Google Search Console analytics, properties, sitemaps, and URL inspection through MCP.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_CREDENTIALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a Google service account JSON file. Omit to use Application Default Credentials.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_ALLOWED_SITES
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of Search Console properties.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable sitemap submission and deletion tools.
